chunks: And in another report, he said:
"He should pray in it, and when he finds water, he should wash it and repeat the prayer."

key_terms.الصَّلَاةَ: The salat (prayer) that is to be repeated.
key_terms.غَسَلَهُ: He washed it to remove impurity.

ai.seo_question: What should a person do if he prays in an impure garment and later finds water?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning prayer in a garment or item when water is unavailable. Once water is found, the item is to be washed and the prayer repeated, indicating the importance of ritual purity in salat (prayer).
